headingBefore: Luxury tax not payable on subject aircraft and subject vessels
headingAfter: Removal of the luxury tax on sales of aircraft and vessels
before: On November 4, 2025, the Government of Canada announced, through Budget 2025, that the luxury tax would no longer be payable on subject aircraft and subject vessels starting on November 5, 2025. For more information, refer to Notice LTN5, Luxury tax not payable on subject aircraft and subject vessels.
after: The Government of Canada has tabled legislation proposing to remove the luxury tax on sales of aircraft and vessels effective November 5, 2025. For more information, refer to Notice LTN5, Luxury tax not payable on subject aircraft and subject vessels.
